argv: import datetime,hashlib,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess; p=pathlib.Path(shutil.which("codex")).resolve(); print("UTC",datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()); print("REVISION",subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()); print("CODEX_EXECUTABLE",str(p)); print("CODEX_SHA256",hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()); print("HELPERS",json.dumps({s:shutil.which(s) for s in ["unshare","bwrap","docker","podman","timeout","setsid","systemd-run"]},sort_keys=True)); print("No config, environment values, auth files or daemon information read.")

argv: import datetime,hashlib,json,urllib.request; print("UTC",datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()); urls=["https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/non-interactive-mode.md","https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/config-file/config-reference.md","https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/build-skills.md","https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/permissions.md","https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/sandboxing.md"]; rows=[(u,urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=15)) for u in urls]; docs=[(u,r.geturl(),r.status,r.read()) for u,r in rows]; [print(json.dumps({"requested_url":u,"final_url":v,"http_status":s,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(b),"markers":{k:k in b.decode() for k in ["turn.completed","input_tokens","cached_input_tokens","reasoning_output_tokens","model_reasoning_effort","agents.enabled","skills.config","token_budget","seed",":read-only",":root"]}},sort_keys=True)) for u,v,s,b in docs]
